summary.headline: Mars and the Native’s Vigor
summary.text: Astrological judgments on vigor and boldness: Jupiter’s favorable aspect and reception with Mars strengthen the native, while Saturn, watery signs, angular placements, and lots of boldness and military signify weakness, violence, theft, robbery, impiety, and military honor or disgrace.
